text:
Maya: Quick sync: field needs a concrete prioritization for private deploy networking before Q3 plan. can we align?
Aisha: +1. recurring asks: IP preservation, egress pinning in UI, smaller airgap bundle.
Ben: Also a simpler installer for offline customers. suggest a "slim" install mode that skips optional telemetry.
NetOps-Alice: From NetOps: 1) preserve public IPs during upgrades 2) allow customer-managed NAT/egress 3) deterministic failover posture across regions.
Jordan: We must avoid intrusive DB/schema updates in early upgrades. zero-downtime path is critical.
Maya: Proposal: three delivery lanes: operator (k8s), standalone (VM/installer), relay (behind NAT). each lane has its own QA/launch gates.
Ben: For relay lane, ship a shim proxy v1 to handle outbound translation, buy time for peering.
Aisha: Field tested a relay proxy with ACME last month. worked but hit crash-loop on token refresh. needs hardening.
Rafael: Relay deps: cert rotation, handshake tokens, metrics. add a /diag endpoint for field troubleshooting.
Maya: Draft launch criteria: operator & standalone: minor upgrades w/ zero-downtime for <10 nodes; relay: stable proxy with IP-preserve toggle; installer: offline bundle + manual egress doc; docs + runbook + rollback <= 30m (target).
Ben: rollback <30m is aspirational for complex nets. mark as target not block.
Aisha: Field priority list to present to sales: 1) IP-preserve toggle 2) operator upgrade path 3) egress pinning UI.
NetOps-Alice: Add an automated canary that validates egress IP post-upgrade. smoke test would catch regressions.
Maya: Good. add canary to rollout checklist.
Jordan: Installer flags we validated: --mode=standalone --egress=preserve --operator=false --k8s-version=1.25
Maya: Can we map asks into impact vs effort matrix for GTM?
Rafael: Quick estimate: IP-preserve = medium effort / high impact; relay shim = low effort / medium impact; operator zero-downtime = high effort / high impact.
Maya: Rafael send estimates by EOD and I'll prepare slides for Tue GTM sync.
Ben: Observability needs: token-level traces for handshake failures, network event metrics.
Aisha: Adding console backlog ticket for egress events and net traces.
DeployBot: notice: build 2025.3.0 staging scheduled at 1759070000.
Maya: We'll use that staging build for relay hardening tests.
Jordan: Capture two customer upgrade stories as acceptance tests to unblock procurement.
Maya: Next steps: Rafael impact numbers (EOD), Maya assemble roadmap slide + acceptance cases, Aisha draft runbook, Ben spike on slim installer. sync Tue 10am. :thumbsup:
